Former Navy pilot Ryan Graves tells Rogan, in a segment of the Joe Rogan Experience, about his own UFO encounter. Graves flew F/A-18 jets off carriers and later founded a group for pilots who see unexplained objects. His account is calm, precise, and hard to wave off.

He describes objects his squadron tracked off the East Coast, shapes and speeds that did not fit known aircraft. Rogan asks how the Navy handled the reports and why pilots stayed quiet for so long. The segment is a key first-hand record in the modern wave of military UFO testimony.

Dr. Rick Strassman, the psychiatrist who ran the first modern human DMT studies, returns to the Joe Rogan Experience for episode 2385. His 1990s work at the University of New Mexico gave volunteers pure DMT and recorded what they saw. His book DMT: The Spirit Molecule made him famous.

Strassman updates Rogan on where the science stands and what users still report. They discuss the beings so many volunteers describe meeting, and whether those beings could be real. He also talks faith, biology, and his later work on prophecy. Few guests can match his firsthand grip on this drug.
